name: Tobian
region: Hatohobei (Tobi), Palau; now mostly Echang, Koror
orthography_note: IPA, with the inventory of van den Berg (2014: 14-23): ts = t͡ʃ, h = x, r = ɾ, y = j; bw and mw (her velarized [bˠ], [mˠ]) are written bʷ and mʷ as in the other Chuukic lects (decision vandenberg2014-symbols).
notes: South-West Islands of Palau. van den Berg (2014: 6-10) places Hatohobeian and Sonsorolese together as the westernmost group of the Chuukic continuum, closer to each other than to their eastern neighbours, and describes them together; Jackson's (1983) tree, which she cites, does not include them. Placed under Proto-Chuukic beside Sonsorolese and Pulo-Annan, which also have no intermediate node. Glottolog 5.4: Tobian (tobi1238, ISO tox), in the family Sonsorol-Tobi (sons1245) with Sonsorol. No correspondence rows yet: the lect is shown by its sourced inventory.
